fields.name: Grain Query Definitions
fields.responsibility: Registers, per grain type, which query reads that grain's state, which writes it and which clears it, and whether each returns its result as output parameters or as a result set — accepting either a stored procedure or a lazily loaded statement file for any of the three independently. It refuses at the point of use, rather than silently doing nothing, when a grain type is persisted but one of its three queries was never supplied.
